question.content: Which of the following sentences best describes a tall, thin boy in Hindi? [[☃ radio 1]]

choices.misconception: This translates to 'That boy is short,' focusing on height but getting the adjective wrong.

choices.content: वह लड़का लंबा और पतला है।

choices.misconception: This translates to 'That boy is fat,' focusing on body shape but choosing the wrong adjective.
This translates to 'That boy is fast/smart,' confusing physical description with ability or intelligence.

hints.content: What are the Hindi words for 'tall' and 'thin'?
The Hindi word for 'tall' is 'लंबा' (lamba) and the Hindi word for 'thin' is 'पतला' (patla). You need a sentence that includes both these words to describe the boy.
The correct sentence will use 'लंबा' (lamba) and 'पतला' (patla) in the correct order. The correct sentence is 'वह लड़का लंबा और पतला है।' (vah ladka lamba aur patla hai).

question.content: Riya wants to tell her friend that she needs a new notebook for her Hindi class. Which of the following sentences is the most appropriate way for Riya to express her need in Hindi? [[☃ radio 1]]

choices.misconception: Student confuses 'I have' (मेरे पास है) with 'I need' (चाहिए).
Student confuses 'This is' (यह है) with 'I need' (चाहिए).

hints.content: Which word in Hindi expresses the idea of 'want' or 'need'?
The word 'चाहिए' (chahiye) is used to express a need or want. The sentence structure is usually 'मुझे [item] चाहिए' (mujhe [item] chahiye), meaning 'I need [item]'.
The correct sentence should include 'चाहिए' to indicate Riya's need for a notebook. The sentence should translate to 'I need a new notebook'.

question.content: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वाक्य भूतकाल (past tense) को दर्शाता है? [[☃ radio 1]]

choices.content: मैं कल फिल्म देखूँगा। (Main kal film dekhunga.)
मैंने कल फिल्म देखी। (Maine kal film dekhi.)
मैं फिल्म देख रहा हूँ। (Main film dekh raha hoon.)
मैं फिल्म देखता हूँ। (Main film dekhta hoon.)

hints.content: भूतकाल क्या होता है? (What is the past tense?)
भूतकाल उन घटनाओं को दर्शाता है जो पहले ही हो चुकी हैं। (The past tense describes events that have already happened.)
वाक्य 'मैंने कल फिल्म देखी' बताता है कि फिल्म देखने की क्रिया कल हो चुकी थी। (The sentence 'Maine kal film dekhi' indicates that the action of watching the film happened yesterday.)
